_comment: Trail bundle manifest — the agent's disambiguation output. The intake request names a primary route plus side routes; each route resolves to ordered OSM way ids (pipeline chains them end-to-end) and MVUM route ids for designation overlay. Raw geometry: raw/osm-routes.json, raw/mvum-*.geojson.
name: Bunce School Road + Ironclads + T-33
request: bunce school road plus t-33 crash site and ironclads trails

routes.name: Ironclads Road (FR 216.1)
routes.notes: The north-end connection to the Lateral is unmapped in the cached OSM geometry (about 402 m). An older trip report describes a rocky climb and a gated/private-property exit; it is historical context, not current access evidence. Do not assume a connected driving loop.

routes.name: Ironclads Lateral (FR 216.1A)
routes.notes: Cached OSM explicitly tags this leg motor_vehicle=no. The manifest associates FR 216.1, but the Lateral is labeled FR 216.1A; agency designation and ownership need verification. An older trip report describes a gated exit near private property. No connected driving itinerary is established.

routes.name: T-33 Crash Site (FR 203.1 North Basin + crash trail)
routes.notes: Includes North Basin and the short crash-site segment. The latter is tagged highway=path with ATV/4WD tags in OSM; route type and motorized access need agency verification rather than an inferred walking/driving classification.
